description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Darius''' gains [[File:Armor penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Armor penetration]] armor penetration.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Darius''' sweeps his axe in a cone in the target direction, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 1 second while [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pulling]] enemies hit towards him. Upon arrival, they rebound 150 units off of him, remaining [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] and becoming [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 40% for 1 second.
description2.text: Active: Darius sweeps his axe in a cone in the target direction, granting sight of the area for 1 second while pulling enemies hit towards him. Upon arrival, they rebound 150 units off of him, remaining airborne and becoming slowed by 40% for 1 second.

description3.raw: '''''Darius''' is unable to move or cast [[File:Darius Decimate.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Decimate|An icon for Darius's ability Decimate]] [[Darius#Decimate|Decimate]] or [[File:Darius Noxian Guillotine.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Noxian Guillotine|An icon for Darius's ability Noxian Guillotine]] [[Darius#Noxian Guillotine|Noxian Guillotine]] for 0.4 seconds after Apprehend's cast time.''
description3.text: Darius is unable to move or cast Decimate or Noxian Guillotine for 0.4 seconds after Apprehend's cast time.

notes.text:
Enemies hit by Apprehend will quickly be dragged to Darius before rebounding over a longer period.
* The slow duration starts as soon as the target rebounds off of Darius.
* PENDING FOR TEST:: The rebound location is determined when the target reaches Darius' location.
* The rebound's forced movement's duration is roughly 0.5 seconds, finishing before the airborne duration ends.
* PENDING FOR TEST:: There is no stun applied for the same duration of the airborne, meaning brittle cannot extend the disable duration. It will not increase the slow duration in most situations because of the negative tenacity falling off before the slow is applied.
After the pull, Darius will attempt to basic attack the closest pulled target, prioritizing enemy champions.
The armor penetration stacks multiplicatively with other forms of percentage armor penetration.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
